user.title: Blues Airnote
user.description:
Paste the URL below into your [Airnote device configuration page](https://airnote.blues.io):

`{webhook_url}`

**Note:** Your Home Assistant instance must be publicly accessible with an external URL configured (Settings → System → Network).

abort.already_configured: Airnote is already configured. Only one device is supported in v1.
abort.no_url_available: No external URL is configured for Home Assistant. Set one in Settings → System → Network before adding this integration.
